'''Rybcoarse''' was a bio-engineered compound used in cybernetics.

A material designed to mimic the operation of a muscle, Rybcoarse cybernetics were wrapped around muscles to provide additional reinforcement and added strength and stamina. Rybcoarse was most notably used in [[Cardio-Muscular Package]]s, and was capable of tripling already existing muscle strength.
